release_summary: RomWeakAuras gains a unified aura editor, resource and durability displays; KittyCombo, Cherry's Chat and Cherry's Grid receive fixes; ZShop adds a helper-clock fallback.
runtime_validation: Share-format and packaging checks run offline; client rendering, input, audio, events and the helper-clock integration require in-game validation.
